text.cn: 輕軌真的從居民樓穿過。觀景平台上相機比人多，你的站位決定今天的 sanity。
text.en: The monorail really does pierce the building. More cameras than people — your spot decides today's sanity.

text.cn: 耐心等那一班『穿樓瞬間』。
text.en: Wait patiently for the through-building moment.

text.cn: 擠進最佳機位（可能被肘擊）。
text.en: Fight for the best angle (elbows possible).

text.cn: 💰 幫外國團用英語解說『這樓為什麼被火車穿過』，收小費。
text.en: 💰 Explain in English why a train goes through a building — collect tips.

feedback.cn: 你成了臨時導遊。有人以為你住在那棟樓裡。
feedback.en: You became a temp guide. Someone assumed you lived in that building.

lockedHint.cn: 精神面貌太差（Sanity < 70），没人想付钱找你。
lockedHint.en: You look too drained (Sanity < 70). Nobody wants to pay you.

text.cn: 李子壩日結束。相機快門聲還在耳裡回放。
text.en: Liziba day ends. Shutter sounds still loop in your ears.
